steps.en: Install at least one agent CLI and log in with your own account
steps.zh: 装好至少一个 agent CLI，用自己的账号登录

steps.en: Install and open OpenMausBot (desktop download, or from a terminal)
steps.zh: 安装并打开 OpenMausBot（下载桌面版，或在终端里跑）

steps.en: Starts its harness on 127.0.0.1 and lists the logged-in CLIs' models in the picker
steps.zh: 在 127.0.0.1 起 harness，把已登录 CLI 的模型列进选择器

steps.en: Create a bot: name, personality, model, optional computer and apps
steps.zh: 建一个 bot：名字、性格、模型，可选电脑和连接的应用

steps.en: Runs each turn by starting that CLI and streams its work into the chat
steps.zh: 每轮对话启动对应 CLI，把它的工作过程实时推进聊天

steps.en: Turns the CLI's permission requests into Allow / Deny cards
steps.zh: 把 CLI 的权限请求变成“允许 / 拒绝”卡片

steps.en: Message bots like contacts and answer their cards
steps.zh: 像给联系人发消息一样派活，回答它们的卡片

value.en: Several agents you already pay for become contacts you message and approve in one app, instead of terminal tabs you babysit
value.zh: 已经付费的几个 agent 变成一个应用里能发消息、能审批的联系人，不用再守着一排终端标签页

sources: https://github.com/milind-soni/OpenMausBot/blob/main/README.md Quick start (requirements: claude, codex or grok installed and logged in; 'They appear in the model picker automatically'), 'Run from a terminal or on a server' (npm install -g openmausbot / npx openmausbot), How it works (harness server 127.0.0.1:8799, drivers over local CLIs, permission broker, one SSE stream)
https://github.com/milind-soni/OpenMausBot/blob/main/README.md Features (bot personality, model picker, computer panel, connected apps, approval cards: Allow / Deny)
https://github.com/milind-soni/OpenMausBot/blob/main/docs/approval-levels.md (approval levels pass through the provider's native permission modes)
